title: Embolic protection adjuncts
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Branch filters
designs.summary: Two generic filter baskets sit inside the brachiocephalic and left common carotid branches and capture debris there. This example does not place a filter in the left subclavian artery.

designs.label: Arch deflector
designs.summary: A generic curved porous screen lies in the aortic arch across the branch origins and deflects debris away from them. It illustrates a different protection arrangement from branch filters.

designs.label: Tubular arch filter
designs.summary: A generic mesh tube lines the aorta from the ascending aorta through the arch to the start of the descending aorta. It covers all three branch origins and captures debris inside it. A small port in its wall admits the valve delivery catheter.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Arch and branches
views.title: Locate protection relative to the aorta and its branches
views.lesson: Three generic arrangements are shown as examples. Branch filters sit inside two of the neck branches and capture debris. A deflector lies along the arch across the branch origins and deflects debris. A tubular filter lines the aorta from the ascending aorta to the descending aorta and captures debris, with a port for the valve catheter. The aorta comes from a real heart model with walls added. The arch branches are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: Compare the three protection locations
views.lesson: Use the design selector to compare branch baskets, an arch screen and a tubular arch filter. The main aortic lumen stays open in all three diagrams.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Protection detail
views.title: Inspect the filtering or deflecting structure
views.lesson: All three generic examples use the same camera to keep their position relative to branch origins clear.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

arch.label: REPRESENTATIVE AORTIC ARCH
arch.body: The curved vessel and branch openings are representative. The source context has no measured arch-branch anatomy.

ascending.label: ASCENDING AORTA
ascending.body: The ascending segment leads toward the arch from the heart.

descending.label: DESCENDING AORTA
descending.body: The arch continues into the descending aorta.

brachiocephalic.label: BRACHIOCEPHALIC ARTERY
brachiocephalic.body: The first illustrated arch branch; one filter is shown inside this vessel in the branch-filter example.

carotid.label: LEFT COMMON CAROTID
carotid.body: The second illustrated arch branch; the branch-filter example places its other basket here.

subclavian.label: LEFT SUBCLAVIAN
subclavian.body: The third illustrated branch has no basket in this branch-filter example. The arch deflector and the tubular filter both extend across its origin.

branch_filter.label: BRANCH FILTER BASKETS
branch_filter.body: Two baskets are inside the selected branches, above their aortic origins. Pores and capture performance are not modeled.

branch_rim.label: BRANCH FILTER RIMS
branch_rim.body: These generic expanded rims remain inside the branch lumens.

arch_screen.label: ARCH DEFLECTOR SCREEN
arch_screen.body: A curved screen lies within the aortic arch across the origins of the three branches. It is not a valve/root implant.

arch_rim.label: ARCH SCREEN FRAME
arch_rim.body: The frame supports the schematic screen while the main aortic passage remains open. Coverage and stroke prevention are not evaluated.

region_branch_filter.label: BRANCH FILTER BASKETS
region_branch_filter.body: Two baskets sit inside the brachiocephalic and left common carotid arteries, just above their origins, with their open ends toward the arch. They capture debris. A shared thin catheter links them; its course is representative.

region_arch_screen.label: ARCH DEFLECTOR SCREEN
region_arch_screen.body: A curved porous screen lies against the roof of the arch across all three branch origins and deflects debris away from them. It has its own thin catheter from the descending aorta.

region_tube_filter.label: TUBULAR ARCH FILTER
region_tube_filter.body: A mesh tube lines the aorta from the ascending aorta through the arch to the start of the descending aorta. It covers all three branch origins and captures debris inside it. Pores and capture performance are not modeled.

region_tube_port.label: ACCESS PORT
region_tube_port.body: A small opening in the filter wall lets the valve delivery catheter enter the filter. The port's exact position is representative.

region_tube_catheter.label: FILTER CATHETER
region_tube_catheter.body: The filter has its own thin catheter, which reaches it from the descending aorta. Its course is representative.

tube_filter.label: TUBULAR ARCH FILTER
tube_filter.body: A mesh tube lines the arch and covers the branch origins. It is open toward the heart and narrows onto its catheter downstream, so debris is captured inside.

tube_port.label: ACCESS PORT
tube_port.body: The valve delivery catheter enters the filter through a small port in its wall. The port's exact position is representative.

tube_catheter.label: FILTER CATHETER
tube_catheter.body: The filter's own thin catheter leaves it at the descending end. Its course is representative.
